question: if triangle {ABC} sim triangle {PQR and } frac{{area}(triangle {ABC})}{{area}(triangle {PQR})} = (25)/(49)then what is the value of AB:PQ?
solution:
**Given:**

ΔABC ∼ ΔPQR

**dfrac{{area}(Delta ABC)}{{area}(Delta PQR)} = dfrac{25}{49}**

**Formula used:**

Area ratio of similar triangles = (Ratio of corresponding sides)²

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0bdb0e60800c9977986ec346fc4404bc3d4ffe29882b9f23f2f1cc88d257f1e2.png] 

dfrac{{area}(Delta ABC)}{{area}(Delta PQR)} = (dfrac{{Side of } Delta ABC}{{Side of } Delta PQR})² 

⇒ dfrac{25}{49} = (dfrac{{} AB}{ PQ})² 

⇒ dfrac{ AB}{{ } PQ} = sqrt{dfrac{25}{49}} 

⇒ dfrac{ AB}{ PQ} = dfrac{5}{7}

The value of AB:PQ = 5:7

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
